Start with what you are planning

Buying and selling are different jobs. Pick the one you are facing and see what the process looks like.

Most buyers want the same thing: the right home, at a price that works, without surprises.

  1. Set your goals and budgetWe talk about where you want to live, what you need, and what you can comfortably spend.
  2. Get pre-approvedA lender reviews your finances. You learn your range, and sellers take your offer seriously.
  3. Tour homes that fitI narrow the list so you see homes that match your goals, not every home on the market.
  4. Make an offerI review recent nearby sales, explain what the price should be, and negotiate for you.
  5. Inspect and closeWe handle the inspection, appraisal, and paperwork until you have the keys.

A home sells best when the price, the condition, and the marketing line up.

  1. Price it with local dataWe review recent nearby sales and set a price that fits the market today.
  2. Get it readyI tell you which repairs and updates are worth the money and which are not.
  3. Market itClear photos and a listing that tells buyers what matters, shown online and through my network.
  4. Review offersI explain every offer, including terms beyond price, and negotiate for the best result.
  5. CloseI manage deadlines and paperwork through closing day.

Where I work

I help buyers and sellers across the Greater Columbia Area and Lake Murray. Each community has its own pace and price range, and I know how they move.

Greater Columbia Area

The capital city and the communities around it. Historic neighborhoods, downtown living, established streets, and new construction close to work and schools.

Lake Murray

Lakefront homes, lake access, and lake-area neighborhoods. Buying near the water has its own rules, and I will walk you through them.

Cities and towns I serve include:

  • Columbia
  • Lexington
  • Irmo
  • Blythewood
  • West Columbia
  • Cayce
  • Forest Acres
  • Chapin
  • Gilbert
  • Elgin
  • Springdale
  • Swansea
  • Pelion
  • and surrounding communities

How I work with you

I know this area

I was born and raised in Lexington. I know the neighborhoods, the roads, and what daily life is like in each one.

You get straight answers

I tell you what I think, and I tell you early. If a house has a problem or a price is too high, you hear it from me first.

I follow through

You will know the next step at every stage. I return calls and texts, and I meet every deadline in your contract.

About me

I am Norman Davis, but everyone knows me as Scott. I was born and raised in Lexington and graduated from Lexington High School in 2001. I still coach there today.

I have served 18 years in the U.S. Army Reserve. The Army taught me to build a plan, communicate it clearly, and finish the mission. I bring that same approach to every client.

I am a REALTOR® with Palmetto Park Team at LPT Realty. My goal is simple. You understand each step, you feel confident in each decision, and you close on your terms.
